download.title: for
download.text: download the installer directly from the website and sign in with a code sent to your email.
steps: download and install the app. approve the system vpn permission if your device requests it.
enter your email and the one-time code from the message.
choose a country and press connect. the home screen will show your connection status.
download.upcoming: this option will be available later. for now, you can use the android and windows apps.

help.title: FAQ
help.contactText: tell us what happened, your device, app version and the time of the error. do not include passwords or sign-in codes.

questions.a: download the [android] or [windows] app, sign in with the code from your email and choose a country. the free plan gives your account one shared hour of connection time per day.
premium has no daily time limit during the paid period. a subscription lasts one calendar month and is renewed manually. your plan and access period are shown in the app.

vpn encrypts traffic between your device and the service server, including on public wi-fi. also use https, app updates and secure sign-in methods to protect your accounts. vpn does not replace device security.

questions.q: vpn will not connect. what should i do?
questions.a: check your internet connection without vpn and update the app. if the error persists, send its text and time to [support].

questions.q: the sign-in code has not arrived?
questions.a: check your email address and spam folder. wait until you can request a new code. if the message does not arrive, contact [support] from your account email address.

questions.q: how do i renew my subscription or request a refund?
questions.a: see the [payment and renewal rules] for details. your plan and expiry date are available in the app. renewal requires a separate payment, with no automatic charges. contact [support] about payments, access or refunds.

terms: PrettyLisaVPN provides vpn access through apps for android and windows. for service, payment and complaint inquiries: help@prettylisavpn.com.
an email address and a one-time code are used to sign in. an account can have up to five active devices. do not share sign-in codes with other people.

the free plan provides one shared hour of connection time per day per account. the allowance resets at 00:00 utc. premium has no daily time limit during the paid period. the plan, remaining time and access period are shown in the app.

vpn encrypts the connection between your device and the service server. speed and availability depend on the network, device and server. vpn does not replace device security or provide absolute anonymity.
use the service lawfully. unauthorized access to other people's systems, malware, spam and attacks on infrastructure are prohibited.
contact support for questions about the app. payment terms and the handling of monetary claims are described on separate pages. these terms do not limit rights granted by applicable law.
privacy: for questions about personal data processing by PrettyLisaVPN: help@prettylisavpn.com.

account operation uses an email address, identifier, status, and creation and modification dates. device management uses the installation identifier, device name and platform, and dates of sign-in and access revocation.

the service processes information about the plan, access period, sign-in events, vpn sessions and technical connection results. this information is needed for authorization, time accounting, connection management, support and evaluation of service performance.

product analytics records account usage events and the technical operation of the service. its events do not include browsing history, visited page addresses, dns queries or packet contents. this describes analytics and is not a claim that no technical logs exist.
when you contact support, your message and attachments are processed. do not send passwords, one-time codes or complete bank card details.

daily analytics records and reports older than 180 days are removed. support request content and attachments are removed from the operational support database after 30 days. these periods do not mean that all correspondence or all account data is deleted.

The website does not use advertising trackers. The billing portal uses a secure HttpOnly cookie for up to two hours and a local pending operation identifier to recover after closing the page. Payment credentials are not stored by the website. Language follows the page address; fonts and images load from the service infrastructure.

When you subscribe, your email address, amount and technical operation identifier are sent to Platega to process and match the payment. PrettyLisaVPN stores payment statuses and access periods; bank account and card credentials are handled by the payment provider.
to request information about your data, correction or deletion, contact support from your account email address. you may need to confirm that the address belongs to you.
refunds: for questions about service quality, ending paid access or refunds, write to help@prettylisavpn.com.

include your account email address, payment date and amount, currency, transaction number if available, and a description of your request. for a technical issue, it helps to include the platform, app version, server, approximate time and error text.
do not send a full card number, cvc, banking passwords or one-time codes. hide unnecessary personal data in attached documents.
claims are reviewed in light of the circumstances of the request, the service provided and applicable law. after reviewing the request, support will communicate the decision and next steps.
disconnecting vpn or uninstalling the app does not itself submit a refund request. you must contact support for a monetary claim to be considered.
these rules do not limit rights granted by applicable law.
payments: a paid subscription provides premium access for one calendar month. the period starts after payment confirmation. the exact expiry date is shown in the app.
a calendar month ends on the corresponding day of the following month; if that day does not exist, it ends on the last day of the month. this is not a fixed 30-day period.

SBP subscriptions renew automatically once per calendar month after your consent. The agreed amount stays fixed until cancellation and a new subscription. A one-off payment link does not enable automatic renewal.
You can stop future charges and unlink your bank account in subscription management. Paid access remains until the displayed date. A new subscription uses the price available at that time.

when making a payment, check the plan, currency, total amount and fee information on the payment page. card details and cvc are entered only on the provider's payment page, not on the PrettyLisaVPN website or in emails to support.
send questions about a payment, receipt, access period or incorrect charge to help@prettylisavpn.com. include your account email address and information that can identify the payment.
the maximum amount per transaction is 10,000 RUB. balance top-ups and custom amounts are not offered. payments are not available yet.
